subject: Post-report interim attestation cover note request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@montarahealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim attestation / cover note to bridge SOC 2 report period

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this — Montara is in the final stages of our vendor review and we need a short-term attestation that covers the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date (report end: 2026-06-30) up to the procurement review date. Specifically we need:

- A signed, dated interim attestation (cover note) confirming that there have been no material changes to the SOC 2 controls in scope since 2026-06-30, or a short list of any changes and compensating controls.
- Confirmation of KMS/encryption posture for customer data and backups since the report end date.
- Any supporting artifacts that are reasonable (controls summary, change log).

Our procurement deadline is 2026-09-16. If you can provide a DocuSign-ready PDF or let us know if a signed PDF is expected, that would help. I attached our procurement checklist to show the items they're asking for.

Appreciate a turnaround this week if possible.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Montara Health
Attachments: Montara_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (Excel)

Subject: Re: Request: interim attestation / cover note to bridge SOC 2 report period

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. Looping in Karthik (Security & Compliance) and Naomi (Legal) to draft the attestation and confirm required artifacts.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce an interim attestation (short cover note) signed by our compliance lead that states the scope of the original SOC 2 Type II report and any material control changes since 2026-06-30.
- We will supply a brief controls change log and a controls summary.
- We can deliver a DocuSign-ready PDF (preferred) unless you require an alternative.

Attached: a copy of our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted public version) and a current controls summary so you have context while we prepare the attestation. Target timeline: draft attestation within 48 hours, final signed by 2026-09-10 if there are no substantive changes.

Karthik / Naomi — can you take point on drafting the cover note and confirm whether the attestation should reference specific control IDs or remain at a higher, descriptive level? Also please flag any controls evidence we should include.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@montarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: interim attestation cover note (questions + evidence list)

Hi all — thanks Ben. I attached a first-pass draft of the interim attestation, plus a short controls-change log covering 2026-07 through 2026-09. High-level summary: there have been no material modifications to the in-scope controls since the report end date. We did ship a minor backend key rotation procedure and an update to our automated backup verification (both planned changes, documented, and with no impact to control objectives).

To be explicit:
- KMS posture: Customer encryption-at-rest continues to be managed via customer-specific keys in our KMS. There were no changes to the key management architecture affecting customer data since 2026-06-30; key rotation cadence remained as documented in the report.
- Backups / retention: Retention policy unchanged; backup verification process had a minor automation enhancement (more frequent integrity checks) — no widened access or control slippage.

Questions for Montara:
1) Do you require the attestation to enumerate control IDs (e.g., CC7.1, CC6.3) or is a descriptive statement sufficient for procurement?
2) Is a DocuSign-signed PDF acceptable? If yes, we'll send the request to be signed by our Compliance Director.

Attachments: interim-attestation-draft-v1.docx (Word — draft), controls-change-log-202607-202609.xlsx (Excel)

If no objections, we'll incorporate Naomi's legal language and produce a finalized PDF for signature.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
